suggestions: I'm grateful for a CI pipeline that went green on the first push after three failed attempts last week.
I'm thankful for the particular quiet of a kopitiam at 6am before the uncles start arguing about football.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a client payment clearing a day early, right when the bills were due.
I'm thankful for finding a parking spot right outside the surau with ten minutes to spare before Maghrib.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that actually taught me something instead of just nitpicking semicolons.
I'm thankful for my dad still waiting up to unlock the gate even though I have my own key now.
I'm grateful for the aircon in my room finally kicking in after a day this humid.
I'm thankful for a Postman test suite that caught the bug before QA did.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of still having both parents around to call when I don't know what to do.
I'm thankful for the one traffic light on the way to the office that's somehow always green lately.
I'm grateful for a staging environment that actually matched production for once.
I'm thankful for nasi lemak from the mamak downstairs tasting exactly the same as it did five years ago.
I'm grateful for a Friday where nobody pinged me after 6pm.
I'm thankful for waking up on my own before the alarm, with just enough time to pray Fajr properly instead of rushing it.
I'm grateful for a senior engineer who said "good catch" instead of "why didn't you see this earlier."
